lead: `Core\Csv::format` takes no `escape` knob, and the module doc's dialect section reads as though it does.
body: `csv.rs`'s *The dialect: three bytes* names `{separator?, quote?, escape?}`, which is the reader's set; `FORMAT_OPTIONS` is `separator`, `quote` and `header`, and the writer's only spelling of an inner quote is doubling. A case planning to turn `{escape:}` on the writer against `fputcsv`'s fifth argument has nothing to turn; what it can measure is that PHP's `""` dialect is this writer's.

until.arg: crates/nvs-stdlib/src/csv.rs:are the three knobs every real CSV dialect
